text:
incident-bot: PAGER -> High 5xx/504 spike observed across apigw-eu-west and apigw-us-central. Error rate ~13% (5m). Severity: P0. Runbook: apigw-high-5xx. Paging on-call.

alice_oncall: ack I'm on it, joining. grabbing dashboards + curl tests. :mag_right:

charlie_sre: quick look — a bunch of upstream timeouts to origin pool A, 504s with `connection reset by peer` in the logs. Also seeing increased TLS handshakes failing.

ben_infra: checking NLB health and backend healthchecks now. no node crashes, some 5xx from backend instances in pool A. I'll try shifting traffic off pool A to pool B.

alice_oncall: good plan. dana, do we have customer impact numbers? which endpoints?

dana_prod: /api/generate and /v1/embeddings are highest. EU region worst: ~18% failed requests for embeddings in last 5m. top affected customers: partner-X, analytics-saas-42. tickets incoming.

ben_infra: executing controlled traffic shift:
```
/ops traffic shift --from apigw-eu-west-poolA --to apigw-eu-west-poolB --percent 100 --reason "origin timeouts"
```

deploy-bot: traffic-shift job started (job id ts-1785-42).

charlie_sre: after shift in EU: 504s down to ~2.6% in last 2m. US still elevated (6-7%). logs show fewer TLS resets from pool B.

ben_infra: applied temporary circuit-breaker to pool A (outbound retries=1, upstream_timeout=1s) to reduce downstream queueing. patch applied via ops-runbook.

alice_oncall: good. frank, can you stand up a spare inference-replica pool for US to absorb traffic while we investigate origin health? ETA?

frank_engineer: spinning up dedicated replica pool (dedicated-infer-us). ETA ~8m. will attach to apigw-us-central.

eve_support: heads-up: drafting status page blurb and customer outbound for top affected accounts. will post once we confirm stabilization. :writing_hand:

charlie_sre: note — correlation with a config rollout to origin autoscaler 23:14 UTC; trying to reproduce locally. capturing stack traces and slow traces.

alice_oncall: if the traffic shift + CB keeps errors <3% for 10m, we can degrade to SEV-2 and keep monitoring. until then keep pages active. everyone, please add short notes to the incident thread.

ben_infra: applied a targeted iptables tweak on a handful of backend hosts that were showing socket exhaustion; patched connection backlog. hoping that'll reduce transient resets.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: dedicated-infer-us attached (job id dep-1785-99).

charlie_sre: US 504s down to ~2.8% after attach and iptable fix. RTTs normalized.

dana_prod: customer error rate back to baseline for majority — still monitoring partner-X flows.

alice_oncall: handing monitoring & RCA start to night oncall @grace_oncall. checklist: verify error rate <3% for 30m, capture traces for 23:14 UTC rollout, preserve logs, notify affected teams, schedule postmortem. leaving page open until grace confirms.

grace_oncall: ack, taking over. I'll keep an eye on dashboards and start RCA notes. please post any missed context in thread.

eve_support: status page posted (internal link) and targeted emails queued for partners. will send once grace gives green.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated — 504/5xx rates returned to baseline after traffic shift + backend fixes. Postmortem scheduled: https://redwood.example.com/incidents/1785123456/postmortem (placeholder).

alice_oncall: thanks team. next actions: deep-dive on autoscaler rollout, add stronger preflight for origin config changes, consider automated early circuit-breaker on socket exhaustion signals.

grace_oncall: will own the RCA doc and runbook updates. marking on-call handoff complete.

incident-bot: This thread will remain open for notes. Closing pager for now. :white_check_mark:
